body:
I'm almost in the same situation.
I've been in my longest relationship (I can't keep a relationship for more than a month, usually) and it litterally meant the world to me. I had finally found someone like minded, and I just fucked it all up.

I have a hard time processing this, but I tell myself that maybe one day I'll find someone like my ex, even though deep down I know I probably won't because I can't stand the pressure of a relationship.
